%@ 删不掉，投不进去: %@ couldn't be removed, so it bounced off
%@ 正在运行，投不进去: %@ is running, so it bounced off
%lld 组文件有重复，多出来的副本占了 %@: {%lld set|%lld sets} of duplicates; the extra copies take %@
CPU 一直很忙: The CPU has been busy for a while
Claude、Codex、Cursor 等 AI 工具留下的缓存、运行时、模型和: Caches, runtimes, models and conversations left by Claude, Codex, Cursor and other AI tools. Caches are ticked; big downloads and conversations are only listed, for you to decide.
Windows 自带的清理工具，能清掉更新留下的旧文件。: Windows' own cleanup tool; it can remove files left behind by updates.
npm、Gradle、Cargo、pip 等包管理器下载的缓存，需要时会重新下载: Downloads cached by npm, Gradle, Cargo, pip and other package managers. They come back when needed.
下载文件夹中很久没碰过的文件。这是你自己的文件，请确认后再勾选。: Files in Downloads you haven't touched in a long time. These are your own files, so check before ticking.
下载文件夹里的 .exe / .msi 安装包，装完通常就不需要了。默认不勾选。: .exe and .msi installers in Downloads, usually not needed once installed. Not selected by default.
个人文件夹里体积很大的文件。: Very large files in your home folder.
从 Windows 的应用列表里读取: Reading the list of installed apps from Windows
从第一次清理到现在，一共扔掉了这么多: Everything you've tossed since the first clean
以后不再列出 %@，可以在设置里恢复: %@ won't be listed again. You can undo this in Settings.
会打开 %@ 自己的卸载程序，按它的步骤完成。卸载完回到 Crumple，列表会: %@'s own uninstaller will open; follow its steps. When you come back to Crumple, the list updates itself.
关掉占资源的应用，管住开机自己启动的程序，再做几项常用维护。: Close resource-hungry apps, rein in programs that start with Windows, and run a few common maintenance tools.
关掉的启动项不会被删除，和任务管理器里的“禁用”一样，随时可以再打开。: Switching a startup app off doesn't remove it. It's the same as “Disable” in Task Manager and can be turned back on any time.
内存 %lld%% 已用 · 不用的就先关掉: %lld%% of memory in use · close what you don't need
内存占 30%、磁盘 25%、CPU 20%；最弱的一项会把总分压在它的分数加: Memory counts 30%, disk 25%, CPU 20%; the weakest part keeps the total within 35 points of its own score.
内容一模一样的文件，每组只留一份。: Files with identical contents; one of each stays.
删除失败（受系统保护或正在使用）: Couldn't remove it (protected by the system or in use)
副本都扔掉了，每份文件只留下一份: The extra copies are gone; one of each is left
卸载由应用自己的卸载程序完成，它可能会问你几个问题。: The app's own uninstaller does the work, and it may ask you a few questions.
另一份已经不在了，%@ 要留着: The other copy is gone, so %@ stays
只会列出来，默认一个都不勾选；系统文件夹和程序文件夹会被跳过: Only listed, nothing is selected by default; system and program folders are skipped
只会删除记录，不影响任何文件。: Only the history is cleared. No files are touched.
只会读取，不会动任何文件，放心扫描: Scanning only reads; no file is touched
只读取 Windows 的应用列表；卸载交给应用自己的卸载程序，和“设置 › 应: Only reads Windows' list of apps; uninstalling is left to each app's own uninstaller, as in Settings › Apps
在桌面、文档、下载、视频、音乐和图片里，\n找出内容一模一样的文件，每组只留一份:
Finds files with exactly the same contents in Desktop, Documents,
Downloads, Videos, Music and Pictures, and keeps one of each.
在桌面、文档、下载、视频、音乐和图片里，\n找出超过 %@ 的文件，看看是谁占了:
Finds files over %@ in Desktop, Documents, Downloads,
Videos, Music and Pictures, so you can see what's taking up room.
已为你勾选 %@ 可以放心清理的内容。正在运行的应用和你自己的文件默认不动。: %@ of safe-to-clean items is ticked for you. Running apps and your own files are left alone by default.
应用和安装程序留下的临时文件，至少一周没动过。正在使用的会自动跳过。: Temporary files left by apps and installers, untouched for at least a week. Files in use are skipped.
应用和系统组件写下的运行日志与崩溃报告。: Logs and crash reports written by apps and system components.
废纸篓已清倒，空间已释放。: The Trash is empty and the space is free.
废纸篓里的所有项目都会被永久删除，无法恢复。: Everything in the Trash will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
打开 Windows 自带的工具；带锁的需要管理员同意: Opens Windows' own tools; those with a lock need an administrator's approval
找出临时文件、浏览器缓存、日志和多余的安装包，\n把它们揉成纸团，扔进纸篓。:
Finds temporary files, browser caches, logs and leftover installers,
crumples them up and tosses them in the basket.
找到 %lld 个大文件，共 %@: Found {%lld large file|%lld large files}, %@ in total
把这次扔掉的文件从废纸篓放回原处: Put the files from this clean back where they were
拖起任意一行，亲手甩进右下角的纸篓: Drag any row and toss it into the basket in the corner
撤销：把这次扔掉的文件全部放回原处: Undo: put every file from this clean back where it was
放回了 %lld 个，%lld 个已不在废纸篓里: Put back {%lld file|%lld files}; %lld missing from the Trash
整理机械硬盘、修剪固态硬盘，让读写更快。: Defragments hard disks and trims SSDs so they read and write faster.
文件在废纸篓里，清倒后才会真正释放空间。: The files are in the Trash. Empty it to actually free the space.
检查缓存、日志和安装包，清理前由你确认: Review caches, logs and installers before cleaning
每次清理都会记在这里：\n扔了多少、什么时候、用的是哪种方式。:
Every clean is noted here:
how much, when, and how.
每组都会留下一份（见每行的“和…一样”），列出来的是多出来的副本。: One file of each set stays (see “same as …” on each row); the list shows the extra copies.
没保存的内容会丢失。只在它卡住、没反应时这样做。: Unsaved work will be lost. Only do this when it's stuck and not responding.
没有找到重复的文件，每份都是独一无二的: No duplicates. Every file is one of a kind.
没能放回：文件已经不在废纸篓里，或原处已有同名文件: Couldn't put it back: the files left the Trash, or something with the same name is in their place
没能清空回收站，稍后再试一次: Couldn't empty the Recycle Bin. Try again in a moment.
浏览器为了加快打开网页保存的数据，删除后会自动重新生成。浏览器开着时投不进纸篓，: Data browsers keep to load pages faster; it's rebuilt automatically. A browser's cache can't go in the basket while it's open, so close it first.
清倒废纸篓之后，这些空间才会真正腾出来。: The space is freed once the Trash is emptied.
登录时自己跑起来的程序: Programs that start when you sign in
看看哪些程序在后台跑、开机时启动了什么。: See what's running in the background and what starts with Windows.
看看每个文件夹各占了多少，点进去一层层找。: See how much each folder takes, and dig in level by level.
看看能腾出多少空间: See how much space you can free
看看装了哪些应用、各占多少空间，\n用它们自己的卸载程序干干净净地卸掉。:
See which apps are installed and how much room each takes,
and remove them cleanly with their own uninstallers.
网页打不开或跳到旧地址时试试。: Try this when pages won't load or go to an old address.
装上最新的修复和驱动。: Get the latest fixes and drivers.
让 Windows 自动清理临时文件和回收站里的旧文件。: Let Windows clean temporary files and old Recycle Bin items automatically.
谢谢光临 · 把垃圾揉成纸团: Thank you · crumple up the junk
还没有忽略任何东西。在列表里右键一项，选“忽略”。: Nothing ignored yet. Right-click an item in a list and choose “Ignore”.
这个应用正在运行，它的缓存投不进纸篓，先退出它再试: This app is running, so its cache won't go in. Quit it first.
这里的文件和文件夹（包括里面的一切）不会出现在任何扫描结果里。: These files and folders (and everything inside) never show up in scan results.
选择一个应用查看详情: Choose an app to see details
逐字节比对，名字不同也能认出来；只有内容完全相同才算重复: Compared byte by byte, so renamed copies are found too; only identical contents count
